note: Original intermediate logs remain in the local preparation evidence directory; these records preserve their outcome and hashes. Successful raw evidence is retained here.

attempts.failure: The initial PECL configuration required unavailable Brotli development files.
The extension build required OpenSSL headers even with its SSL option disabled.
attempts.repair: Install libssl-dev in the disposable image.

attempts.failure: Strict analysis rejected implicit truthiness of three native API return values.
attempts.repair: Compare status/header/end results with true explicitly.

attempts.failure: Nginx attempted to create its default uwsgi temporary directory on a read-only filesystem.
attempts.repair: Move all Nginx temporary paths under /tmp.

attempts.failure: Empty FastCGI CONTENT_LENGTH metadata made framework request parsing reject GET with 400.
attempts.repair: Omit absent CONTENT_LENGTH and CONTENT_TYPE with if_not_empty.

attempts.failure: The client attempted JSON decoding of the canonical plain-text 404/405 responses.
attempts.repair: Assert the actual plain-text routing bodies.

attempts.failure: HTTP checks passed, but shutdown could not find a kill executable in the image.
attempts.repair: Send SIGTERM through Python os.kill and bound the termination wait.

attempts.failure: The first benchmark stopped after Nginx closed a keep-alive connection. No complete successful measurement was claimed.
attempts.repair: Honor Connection: close without retrying failed requests; set keepalive_requests=4096 and stream completed samples to JSONL.
